name: Poker Dice
tagline: Bone dice on a battered pirate table. Roll up to three times for the best poker hand and win the doubloon.

modes.name: First to 3
modes.description: Win 3 rounds (doubloons) to win the match.

modes.name: Chat vs Streamer
modes.description: The streamer plays Scarlet, and chat votes on every Ocean move. First to 3.
howTo: The streamer plays Scarlet. Chat plays Ocean by voting: the most popular command wins each step.
Chat's best move: vote !keep with the dice to hold, e.g. !keep 135 holds dice 1, 3, 5 and rolls the rest.
!stand keeps the hand. The best poker hand of the round wins a doubloon.

commands.help: hold exactly dice 1, 3 and 5, then roll
keep your hand and end your turn
mods: switch mode in the lobby

howTo: On your turn: !roll. You get up to 3 rolls.
Hold dice with !1–!5 (or !keep 135 to hold dice 1, 3, 5 and roll), then !roll again, or !stand.
Best poker hand of the round wins a doubloon: five of a kind beats four, full house, straight, three, two pair, pair.
Faces: 9, 10, J, Q, K and the skull (A). First to 3 doubloons wins.
